name: Özyasar Tel ve Galvanizleme Sanayi AS
summary: Özyasar Tel ve Galvanizleme Sanayi AS is a company dedicated to the manufacturing of diverse wire and wire products, with a particular emphasis on hot-dip galvanized wire. Its offerings serve an extensive range of sectors, including energy, infrastructure, cable production, automotive, construction, agriculture, furniture, packaging, white goods, environmental solutions, and security systems. The enterprise was co-founded by Ahmet Çokyasar, Mehmet Çokyasar, and Mustafa Çokyasar on March 14, 1973, and its primary operations are based in Zeytinburnu, Turkey.
